clusters.name: codex-exec-timeout-raise
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial single-member cluster. All three stories target the same plugin (plugins/ralph) with intra-cluster dependencies: US-002 asserts the value US-001 introduces, and US-003's CHANGELOG/AGENTS.md docs describe the final value. Same-plugin parallel would conflict on the version-stamp, CHANGELOG, and AGENTS.md writes, so there is no parallelism benefit.
